svg.font-family: 'STIX Two Text','STIX Two Math','Times New Roman',serif
svg.title: Conditional parameter correlations at the MAP
svg.desc: Computed matrix of pairwise Pearson coefficients for the 26 parameters of the fitted (5,3,1) distribution, with all remaining coordinates fixed at their MAP values. Colors run from -1 (blue) to +1 (red); printed values show the rounded coefficients of the original figure. The FGF4-LUMEN row and column are outlined.
svg.text: Conditional parameter correlations at the MAP
Pairwise Pearson coefficients; all remaining coordinates fixed at their MAP values
Conditional linear dependence within the fitted distribution; these coefficients do not establish global
